title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
description: Hands-on KillerCoda labs covering all current CKA exam domains.

items.title: Cluster Architecture, Installation & Configuration (25%)
items.description: RBAC, kubeadm installation, highly available clusters, infrastructure, upgrades, and etcd backup and restore

items.title: Workloads & Scheduling (15%)
items.description: Deployments, ConfigMaps, Secrets, private registries, Pod design, scheduling, DaemonSets, static Pods, schedulers, runtime sandboxes, labels, and taints

items.title: Services & Networking (20%)
items.description: Host networking, Pod connectivity, Services, Ingress, and NetworkPolicies

items.title: Storage (10%)
items.description: StorageClasses, PersistentVolumes, volume modes, access modes, reclaim policies, claims, and persistent applications

items.title: Troubleshooting (30%)
items.description: Clusters and nodes, resource usage, container output, and Services and networking
